drafted_from: tool:show-funnel-by-source's own row in tools/traffic-attribution/records.json and its screen in part.json, read before relying on it; what its one read answered on one client's database (no rows, no journey yet) is written in hands_back.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show the funnel by source for my database". It opens the funnel screen at /funnel-by-source with the held database name, one card per source.
no_lists_because: It reads one view of your own database (funnel_by_source) and keeps no row of its own.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show the funnel by source for my database". It needs the held name of that database's connection (the vault name you saved it under).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account with method tools:run, tool tool:show-funnel-by-source and the credential_name input (the worked example shows the call).

3. Read what comes back: columns and rows of funnel_by_source, one row per utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign, with visitors, clicks, visits, leads, bookings, checkouts, sales and revenue_cents. An empty answer means no journey has been recorded yet.
